name: Athena
title: Shield of Wisdom
summary: Shield your allies from your foes whilst empowering your Aegis to inflict powerful attacks to your foes.
lore: Goddess of wisdom and warfare, Athena finds Ryven to be far too unpredictable, far too steeped in havoc. While her loyalties to Olympus have not lessened, she is focused on allegiance with gods of Order from across the pantheons. She works with them to battle Chaos and impose structure on a world that lacks it—whether it wants that structure or not.
archetype_description: Reduce incoming damage by 1% for each piece of plate armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Also place [Radiance II] on all allies for 2 turns.
Inflict an additional 10% MAX HP to enemies under [Petrify] which ignores 100% of the target's DEF but cannot be Critical.
Decrease the Divinity of all enemies by 5% instead. If the attacker is below 50% Divinity, increase the chance to place [Petrify] to 100%.
